Lagrange and TiDB comparison history

The history holds 43 records over 43 combinations. History records are forensic: none is admitted as a current result.

Every comparative result published before 2026-11-01 was withdrawn; the records are retained as forensic evidence. The append-only invalidation ledger has 25 entries; 10 of them name the defect ids behind the withdrawal and 8 of them enumerate the withdrawn records by id (the rest name them by file and campaign commit). 23 of 43 history records are withdrawn without a ledger entry, by the admission rule forensic-record-not-admissible: no history record is admissible as a current claim.

Cell status vocabulary

  • valid-observed: admitted from retained v2 observations
  • product-failure: the product ran and failed; failure counts are shown
  • invalid-measurement: evidence exists but cannot support the claim (reason codes name why)
  • blocked: cannot be measured until a named prerequisite exists
  • unsupported: the configuration cannot express this claim
  • not-measured: no observation exists
